releases.notes:
# v0.2.0 — 1.21.11

## What's new

### Datapack support
Mods can now ship tier definitions via datapack at `data/<namespace>/phats_progression/block_tiers/*.json` and `data/<namespace>/phats_progression/tool_tiers/*.json`. Modpack developers can override mod-shipped defaults by setting `ignore_datapacks: true` in their config files.

### Mining speed for out-of-tier tools
Tools that are below the required tier now mine at bare-hands speed instead of full speed. No more "block breaks but no drops" surprise.

### `/progression` debug command
- `/progression info [item_id]` — show held item or specified item's tier
- `/progression block [block_id]` — show looking-at block or specified block's tier
- `/progression list tools|blocks` — dump all tier assignments to a file
- `/progression reload` — reload configs

### Vanilla tool tier fallback (1.21.1 only)
Tools without explicit config entries now infer their tier from `ToolMaterial`, automatically handling modded tools that use vanilla tier values. Not available on 1.21.11+ where Minecraft removed the underlying API.

### Bug fixes
- Tool type now correctly respected. Previously the mod allowed an iron axe to mine iron ore by tier alone; vanilla's tool-type check is now properly deferred to.
- 1.21.11 default config corrected to match the copper-gates-iron progression.

## Upgrading from v0.1.0
Existing config files keep working. New `ignore_datapacks` field defaults to `false` if missing.

## Known limitations
- Server-required: vanilla clients can't connect to servers running this mod.
- 1.21.11 lacks vanilla tool tier fallback (see "Bug fixes" / API removal).

Full README: https://github.com/Phatdog731/phats_progression

releases.notes:
Initial release of Phat's Progression Framework 1.21.11.
   
   ## What it does
   Config-driven mining tier progression. Default behavior matches vanilla; modpack devs can extend tiers past netherite via simple JSON configs.
   
   ## Requires
   - Minecraft 1.21.11
   - Architectury API
